mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained GDPC1 decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in payroll employment above 200,000 persons signals robust labor market conditions, raising earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 200000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals strengthening aggregate demand, raising corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained GDPC1 increase (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 1.5% signals strengthening manufacturing activity, raising earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO > 1.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate below 1.0% signals an extended monetary easing cycle, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05).
